rows.notes: Higher-ups remain unnamed; later dismissal order informs context but is not revealed here.

rows.en: Commander?
What a dirty trick...! Don't think I'll just back down like this...!
rows.notes: Private anger at the higher-ups; second-person target remains implicit.

rows.en: Um...
Major Yakumo, I'm moving Operation Downfall's start time up by about an hour.
rows.notes: Yakumo is Soichi, whose glossary rank is Major; retains about an hour.

rows.en: What...!? That means we're starting the operation right now...!
Is that what the orders said? What on earth is the reason?
I have no obligation to explain myself to you...!

rows.notes: Repeated silence in three original uses; no added subject or meaning.

rows.en: Operation Downfall begins in five minutes... at 1705. Inform all sections immediately.
Y... yes, sir.

rows.notes: Deliberate silence retained.

rows.en: ...Is that really true!? It's already decided!? B-but...!
Harry, what's wrong?
rows.notes: Coordinator name script: Existing source-scoped spoken nickname Harry; frozen Hari speaker unchanged. Initial full draft retained; no compression.

rows.en: The Lilia Litvyak just informed us that the operation will start in five minutes...!
rows.notes: Retains the received-message trailing delivery; ship spelling follows campaign glossary.

rows.en: In five minutes? That's absurd...! What on earth are they thinking!?
I-I don't know. But it looks like the T.J. Busters in every section are getting ready to activate.
...The most likely explanation is that something happened higher up.
Higher up... You mean Director Watari?
I think it's a little higher than that.
Could the Federation government have...?
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished speculation; no government action supplied.
uncertain: Deliberate unfinished speculation retained.

rows.en: For now, let's follow the orders. Though things are looking pretty ominous.
Yes... They're an enemy we have to face sooner or later...
rows.notes: Enemy refers to Mu inside TOKYO JUPITER, not the Federation government.

rows.en: ...The T.J. Busters at all locations are ready to activate.
What's the status of each unit's RMU system?
rows.notes: RMU left unexpanded.

rows.en: They've already begun idling... All units are operating normally.
How about the PropSat formation overhead?
rows.notes: PropSat follows centralized source transliteration; no acronym expansion, model or capabilities added.
uncertain: PropSat follows the centralized campaign glossary; exact licensed wording remains unverified.

rows.en: They're currently cruising steadily through the designated airspace.
...All systems are green. #部隊名 is also in position...
rows.notes: Runtime squad placeholder preserved and measured at expanded width.

rows.en: All that remains is to await the order from our commanding officer.
Very well. Commence Operation Downfall!
Roger. Operation Downfall, commencing!
Countdown, ten seconds... 9... 8... 7... 6...
At last... Now TOKYO JUPITER's absolute barrier will vanish before our very eyes...
rows.notes: Absolute barrier remains distinct from AT Field; capitals follow glossary.

rows.en: And when it does, those Mulian bastards...!
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished hostile thought; no outcome invented.
uncertain: Deliberate unfinished hostile thought retained.

rows.en: Deploy the stochastic resonance field!
rows.notes: Centralized stochastic resonance field follows approved scientific stem, distinct from stochastic resonance boundary; fictional whole term remains provisional.
uncertain: stochastic resonance field follows the centralized campaign glossary; exact licensed wording remains unverified.

rows.en: H-hey, look!!
Th-that's incredible...!
TOKYO JUPITER's absolute barrier... it's being peeled away...!!
What's wrong, Ayato!?
...N-no...! We can't let this go on...!!
rows.notes: Ayato senses that the current process must not continue; no later reason supplied.

rows.en: Ugh... Uuugh! Aaaah!!
...Report the situation!
Energy at the center has exceeded 215!
rows.notes: 215 retained without an invented unit.

rows.en: It's working... It's working...!!

rows.notes: Pure shock retained.

rows.en: Communication signals are increasing explosively! The time differential effect is at its maximum!
rows.notes: Centralized time differential effect follows source English loanword; no invented physics or acronym.
uncertain: time differential effect follows the centralized campaign glossary; exact licensed wording remains unverified.

rows.en: The absolute barrier is disappearing!

rows.notes: Ayato reacts silently; double exclamation preserved.

rows.en: ! Wh-where am I...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate disoriented question as scene changes.
uncertain: Deliberate disoriented question fragment retained.

rows.en: Y-you're...!!
rows.notes: Deliberate recognition fragment before Mishima is named.
uncertain: Deliberate recognition fragment retained.

rows.notes: Deduplicated silence appears at ten uses; remains neutral silence.

rows.en: Mishima...! Where on earth are we?
This is the passage the people called Mu use to send in the Instrumentalists who join with Xephon...
rows.notes: The passage belongs to Mu; Instrumentalists unite with Xephon. No extra lore supplied.

rows.en: Instrumentalists...?
rows.notes: Deliberate questioning echo of the title.

rows.en: That means the Ollin. The original Ollin came here through this passage too...
rows.notes: Original Ollin is plural in Japanese; English collective noun kept without inventing number.
Ayato's startled silence is a deliberate nonverbal utterance.

rows.en: Ra-ra?
rows.notes: Context settled from the original neighboring dialogue; complete spoken subject/action retained.

rows.en: Ollin...! What's wrong? Did someone call you?
You did... and that egg. Because I must return there...
rows.notes: Answers Quon: you and that egg called the speaker. Hidden label preserved.

rows.en: You're not Ollin, are you...?
That's right... I am Ixtli. The proof of an Ollin who reaches Yolteotl... the song of Rah released from Xephon...
rows.notes: Identity disclosed in body only; speaker remains ???. Poetic appositions retained; song of Rah provisional.
uncertain: song of Rah follows the centralized campaign glossary; exact licensed wording remains unverified.

rows.en: And the form of the person you desire from your true heart...
rows.notes: Continues preceding self-description. True heart retained without substituting Yolteotl.
uncertain: True heart metaphor retained; its precise relation to Yolteotl is not expanded.

rows.en: You have found your song...
Who are you...?
rows.notes: Question restored naturally from genuine unfinished recognition.

rows.en: I am the scale of true tones... Come, you are needed... Ollin.
rows.notes: Centralized scale of true tones preserves the musical/poetic metaphor provisionally. You are needed leaves the unstated agent unspecified.
uncertain: Scale of true tones is a provisional poetic rendering; source leaves who needs Ollin unspecified.

rows.notes: Quon's startled silence is a deliberate nonverbal utterance.

rows.en: Let us become one...
rows.notes: Hidden speaker remains ??? despite the preceding Ixtli declaration.

rows.en: ...So do I... I want to be together...
You... Who are you? Aren't you Mishima?
Reika Mishima is a false name for a true face... I am Ixtli. I am your guide, and your own face that you cannot yet see truly.
rows.notes: Reika identifies herself only in this body; retain Reika speaker label. True-face/false-name/self imagery kept.
uncertain: Poetic self/face imagery is source-literal; licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: This is the world you see, the world I inhabit... The world you and I create... You will attain Yolteotl and become the heart of the world.
rows.notes: Yolteotl terminology retained; no explanation of cosmology added.
uncertain: Poetic world/heart formulation retained; licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: Let us go together... You who are king of the world, and the one offered up...!
rows.notes: Offered up preserves the sacrificial passive without naming an agent.
uncertain: Offered up retains sacrificial wording; exact licensed phrasing unverified.

rows.en: The girl in my painting isn't you...! You aren't the one I wanted to show it to...!
rows.notes: The painting and its intended viewer are distinguished; do not reveal the girl's identity.

rows.en: I didn't paint that picture for you...!!
I won't go with you...!
Even if you don't wish it, it will happen in time.
Besides the two Ollins, there is one more chosen one...
rows.notes: The unnamed third chosen one stays unnamed.

rows.en: You will each turn the gears of your own time... Then either guide the two worlds and those who dwell in them to a new world...
rows.notes: Continuation of three alternative outcomes in rows 333-335, not a definite prediction.
uncertain: Poetic gears-of-time imagery retained; licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: Or bring eternal light to the world with Ra Mu's song...
rows.notes: Ra Mu is the singer here; Star of Ra Mu would add an object absent from the source.

rows.en: Or fail to accomplish the tuning, and return the world to a sea of mud.
rows.notes: Mud sea retained literally; no physical mechanism inferred.
uncertain: Sea of mud retained literally; exact licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: Soon, this world will reach a time of ending and beginning... Of death and rebirth.
And you have very little time left... Do not forget that, Ollin.
I won't go... I won't go with you. I just want to protect... Everyone... This world...!
rows.notes: Source hesitation retained without removing the speaker's subject.
Deliberate unfinished repetition.
uncertain: Deliberate source fragment retained; do not complete the sentence beyond the source row.

rows.en: ...I will go on ahead...
rows.notes: Reika leaves ahead; no destination supplied.

rows.en: EVA-01, the key to the Human Instrumentality Project... If I obtain it, I can become a god!
rows.notes: Human Instrumentality Project canonical; god claim remains Kuki's assertion. Canonical glossary spelling reconciled after immutable draft; no fit compression.

rows.en: A god...!? What does that mean!?
Answer me! What do you intend to do once you have the Star of Ra Mu!?
As I said before, we will bring a great calamity upon you!
I have no intention of fighting Xephon... Accept your destiny willingly and do what you must. That is Lady Maya's wish.
rows.notes: Xephon source-short term, distinct from expanding to RahXephon; Lady Maya preserves servile honorific in this address.

rows.en: What I must do...!?
What is this... pressure...? Is it connected to the absolute barrier's disappearance...!?
rows.notes: Newtype pressure retained; no mechanism for its relation to the barrier asserted.

rows.en: Oh... I have heard the rumors, but so this is what they call a Newtype...
But the future of you so-called new humans will never come!
This is dangerous...! If we don't defeat him here, something will happen...!
You seem to have some sense. But your world will soon close!
Hurry...! I don't know what it is, but this bad feeling has been growing stronger!
You sensed it too. But everything has already begun. This is no matter for you to meddle in!
EVA and Raideen... And MU and RahXephon... The fate of this world...
rows.notes: Deliberate source fragment, continued reflection in row355. Canonical glossary spelling reconciled after immutable draft; no fit compression.
uncertain: Deliberate source fragment retained; do not complete the sentence beyond the source row.

rows.en: Was the disappearance of the absolute barrier really the same as opening Pandora's box...?
What is your goal!? Why do you want EVA and Raideen!?
rows.notes: Canonical glossary spelling reconciled after immutable draft; no fit compression.

rows.en: Masaki Kihara... It is what you tried to do as well.
rows.notes: Kuki calls Masato Masaki Kihara; preserve that addressed name, do not change speaker label.
Same exclamation serves i025b:66 after destiny question and i025b:73 after two Hakke robots report.

rows.en: Though we have no desire for the chaotic destruction you sought!
The absolute barrier has completely vanished!
I did it... I finally did it...! I have accomplished what no one has ever done before...!!
Heh heh... Hahahaha! I, Makoto Isshiki, have erased TOKYO JUPITER's absolute barrier! Hahahaha!!
rows.notes: Canonical glossary spelling reconciled after immutable draft; no fit compression.

rows.en: C-Commander!!
What!?
A MU aerial city has appeared above New York!!
W-what did you say!?
It isn't only New York! Moscow, Beijing, Istanbul...!
MU aerial cities appear to be emerging one after another above cities around the world!!
MU is multiplying...!?
Are the worlds beginning to overlap...!?
rows.notes: Itsuki asks whether worlds are overlapping; preserve the question and internal thought.

rows.en: I-impossible...!!
...How will you respond, Commander?
Itsuki!? What happened!?
W-what is it this time!?
D1 has appeared from the direction of Tokyo!!

rows.notes: Both original uses are identical interjections; same translation retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh...
Th-that man is...!?
Former Colonel Masayoshi Kuki of the Far East Command...! Wasn't he reported missing after the outbreak of the MU War...!?
rows.notes: Full Kuki name and former rank retained; missing-person report remains a question. Existing campaign_terms Far East Command canonical restored per root review. Canonical glossary spelling reconciled after immutable draft; no fit compression.

rows.en: No, he was inside the absolute barrier. As commander of the MU Government-General's Defense Force...!
rows.notes: Commander role inside the barrier is Haruka's correction to Misato.
uncertain: MU Government-General Defense Force institutional wording is literal; official licensed title unverified.

rows.en: ...We have been freed from the prison of time. Let me thank you for helping us achieve that...
W-what!?
And now, we order you to disarm immediately and surrender EVA-01 and the Star of Ra Mu.
rows.notes: Canonical glossary spelling reconciled after immutable draft; no fit compression.
Source startled punctuation retained.
Source shock punctuation-only preserved.

rows.en: E-EVA-01 and the Star of Ra Mu!?
rows.notes: Canonical glossary spelling reconciled after immutable draft; no fit compression.

rows.en: Why those two, rather than RahXephon...!?
There is no doubt that they are demanding Unit-01 to prevent the Human Instrumentality Project...
rows.notes: Misato's inference remains internal, not established narration.

rows.en: But the Star of Ra Mu? What do they intend to do once they have it...!?
You have 24 hours from this moment...
If our demands are refused... A great calamity will descend upon your heads...!
A-a great calamity!?
Does he mean MU will launch an all-out attack...?
Damn it, attack! Attack!! Crush that traitor!!
Are you sure? If this goes badly, the MU above every city may start attacking, you know.
I am your commander now! Obey my orders!!
I don't think you can take responsibility for all the consequences.
rows.notes: Ruri rebukes Isshiki for inability to bear consequences, not lack of command authority.

rows.en: Shut up! All you need to do is obey my orders!!
...I'm afraid we can't do that.
What!?
This is a notice from the Federation government. Makoto Isshiki, effective today, you have been...
rows.notes: Sentence deliberately breaks before the removal announcement in row399.
uncertain: Deliberate source fragment retained; do not complete the sentence beyond the source row.

rows.en: Relieved of your duties as Federation inspector and acting commander of TERRA.
rows.notes: Continues row398, preserving the announcement split.

rows.en: ...You understand why, don't you?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.
Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: You buried the Scientific Research Division's report warning of the dangers of this operation...
rows.notes: Soichi addresses Isshiki; accusation trails into the next row.
uncertain: Accusation deliberately trails into the following row.

rows.en: Then you ignored the Federation government's order to cancel, moved the operation up an hour, and this is the result.
rows.notes: Completes the preceding accusation; one-hour advancement and ignored cancellation both retained.

rows.en: Y-you set me up...!?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Oh, come now... Didn't you bring yourself down?
rows.notes: Soichi turns the setup accusation back on Isshiki, with a mild verbal jab.

rows.en: Heh... Heh heh heh...
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Now then, former Commander. This way, please.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: I... This isn't the end for me... It isn't over...!
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: ! What are you doing!?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: No! The SAM launch lock!
rows.notes: Urgent fragment retained: Itsuki reacts to Isshiki interfering with the SAM launch lock; no specific lock operation or acronym expansion invented.
uncertain: Source retains an urgent incomplete launch-lock instruction; precise requested lock operation is not stated.

rows.en: Hahahaha! You're too late!!
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.
Wordless shock retained before incoming report.

rows.en: W-what just happened!?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: M-missiles have been launched from the Lilia Litvyak!!
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Wh...! Impossible!!
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Hahahahaha! Look! This is what happens when you set me up! You deserve this! This is your punishment!!
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Y-you... How could you...!
rows.notes: Outraged unfinished reaction retained; no new insult added.
uncertain: Outraged reaction remains deliberately unfinished.

rows.en: ...So that is your answer. Then I shall have you all perish here.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: D1 and D2 have assumed attack positions!
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: We have no choice! All units, launch at once! Intercept the enemy!
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Heh, heh heh heh... You have already been warned.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: You have little time left... Surrender EVA-01 and the Star of Ra Mu to us, the Mu, as demanded.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Otherwise, this world will share the same fate as Nirai Kanai...
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Kuki is getting rather carried away. Why him instead of me?
rows.notes: Mamoru addresses Maya about assignment of Kuki; no unstated assignment spelled out.
uncertain: The assignment omitted from the question is left unspecified, as in the source.

rows.en: That isn't your role, is it? You protect the Ollin... And you bear witness to Yolteotl...
rows.notes: Maya assigns Mamoru protection of Ollin and witness to Yolteotl, without explaining the latter.
Source silence retained; omission flagged.

rows.en: U-um... Lady Maya. Is what we're doing really the right thing...!?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Will this really bring about a world that is right...!?
rows.notes: Miwa questions the morally right world; avoids implying a separately named Right World.

rows.en: Miwa, you have nothing to worry about. You will do what is right. So there is no need to worry.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Y-yes...
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Heh. What is right, eh...?
rows.notes: Mamoru skeptically echoes Maya and Miwa.

rows.en: ...Ayato... No, Ollin. I will never forgive you...
rows.notes: Self-correction Ayato to Ollin retained in reveal order.

rows.en: I will never forgive you for killing Hiroko...!
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Mom, look at the sky! The sky!
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Yes... I see it, Otome.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: H-hey... What's that? Is that big thing a Gulfer too...!?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: We'll be okay, right...? Gin and little Lion and the others will protect us, won't they...!?
rows.notes: Otome uses affectionate Gin and Lion nicknames; Lion group left as source wording rather than named Data Weapon substitution.
uncertain: Affectionate Lion nickname has no exact glossary entry; retained literally as little Lion without identifying a Data Weapon.

rows.en: Yes, they will. With those kids out there, we'll be fine. So don't you worry.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Yeah!
rows.notes: Otome affirms; identical afterbattle answer also checked.

rows.en: Gin, Hokuto, Orie... I believe in you. I know you'll protect this world...
rows.notes: Midori speaks inwardly to Gin, Hokuto and Orie; does not normalize Orie to Vega.

rows.en: Hey, Minato. Is dinner ready yet?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.
Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Hm? What's wrong?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: ...The government has just declared a special state of emergency. Residents of the affected areas are urged to remain orderly...
rows.notes: Newsreader broadcast trails off as written.
uncertain: Broadcast sentence deliberately trails off.

rows.en: W-what's this...!? What's this news about...!?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: They say a whole lot of these Mu floating cities have sprung up...
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: This... is serious...
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: ...That concludes the footage of the Mu floating cities that have appeared around the world.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: How are the human scum reacting?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: There is unrest in every region.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Emperor Burai, I believe this is a golden opportunity for us...
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: I am aware.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Then...?
rows.notes: Gura prompts Burai to authorize action; source fragment retained.
uncertain: Prompt remains a source fragment.

rows.en: Yes. Now we shall launch our final operation... and make this world mine.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Hidler, Dr. Gura... You know the arrangements, I trust?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Yes, Your Majesty. First, we take control of Japan...
rows.notes: First stage of the plan trails into Hidler next row.
uncertain: Plan clause deliberately trails into the following speaker.

rows.en: To do so, we pin #部隊名 down outside the Japanese islands...
rows.notes: Hidler continues the plan; trailing clause retained and squad placeholder unchanged.
uncertain: Plan clause deliberately trails into the following speaker.

rows.en: Using Hyakki Fortress Island, we attack the Saotome Institute... We take the Getter Ray amplifier, then wipe out all opposition at once.
rows.notes: Gura continues the linked plan: attack using the island, obtain amplifier, then eliminate obstacles. Tightened only after initial draft measured four lines.

rows.en: Correct. Put the operation into motion at once.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Hyakki, Buraaaaai!
rows.notes: Salute/catchcry, not attack; one extra source long vowel rendered with extra a beyond campaign term baseline.
uncertain: Hyakki salute has source-backed phonetic project rendering; independently canonical English cry remains unestablished.

rows.en: ...So, what about Commander Isshiki?
rows.notes: Misato asks about Isshiki; Commander follows her source wording despite his dismissal.

rows.en: He is in custody until the charges are finalized... Government officials will come to take him into custody shortly.
rows.notes: Custody pending finalized charges; government collection is forthcoming, not completed.

rows.en: ...He deserves no sympathy...
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Major Yakumo, what is the status of those floating cities?
rows.notes: Major Yakumo is the sourced rank and surname for Soichi.

rows.en: They are still multiplying around the world. The cities themselves are stationary, but the areas where they appear are in chaos...
rows.notes: Soichi report trails into following deployment report.
uncertain: Report clause deliberately trails into following row.

rows.en: Federation forces have been deployed to quell the unrest. The government has also declared a special state of emergency.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: I see...
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: Even though the Mu have yet to attack, the situation just keeps getting worse.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Yes. Other enemy organizations are very likely to exploit this chaos and make their move.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: ...That isn't our only problem.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: TOKYO JUPITER's absolute barrier kept the two worlds from overlapping by holding them apart through the difference in their dimensions.
rows.notes: Literal dimensional distinction and barrier function retained; no invented physical mechanism.
uncertain: Dimensional explanation is source-literal; exact physical mechanism is not specified.

rows.en: But we have released them... So our world and the Mu world are now trying to overlap.
rows.notes: Itsuki states overlap is underway after barrier removal, without adding a timescale.

rows.en: What happens if they overlap?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: The same things cannot occupy the same space. When the two worlds overlap completely, they will annihilate each other.
rows.notes: Source says same things cannot occupy same space; mutual annihilation kept as the asserted world outcome, not added matter/antimatter physics.
uncertain: Mutual annihilation translated as world outcome without supplying a physical theory.

rows.en: Th-then what happens to us!?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Naturally, we will share the world's fate.
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Th-that can't be...!
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: Why are you surprised at this point?
rows.notes: Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: NERV foresaw this and has been pursuing a countermeasure... the Human Instrumentality Project, with EVA-01 as its cornerstone. Correct?
rows.notes: Itsuki asks Misato to confirm NERV foresight and project premise; no assertion by Misato implied.
Adjacent FULL scene context reviewed; natural spoken rendering with source tone and speaker spelling preserved.

rows.en: You're saying the Human Instrumentality Project is a countermeasure to prevent the world's destruction...?
rows.notes: Vega questions the implied preventative purpose.

rows.en: I don't think that is an appropriate description, but there is no doubt that aspects of it run counter to the Mu's plans.
rows.notes: Itsuki qualifies the description while affirming opposition to Mu plans; next row supplies Mulian awareness.

rows.en: ...And the Mulians must know that as well.
rows.notes: That refers to the plan having aspects opposed to the Mu plan in preceding fresh479; no added specifics.

rows.en: Is that why they attacked Tokyo-3 so many times...?
rows.notes: They refers to Mulians in previous line; keep Misato causal inference as a question, not fact.

rows.en: ...Isn't there any other way to stop the two worlds from annihilating each other?
rows.notes: Mutual annihilation kept as source-world prediction, with no real particle mechanism added.
uncertain: Mutual annihilation is fictional predicted outcome; licensed full explanation unverified.

rows.en: It may be theoretically possible to recreate the absolute barrier using the T.J. Busters.
rows.notes: Reconstruction is only theoretical and uncertain; no assurance of success added.
uncertain: T.J. Buster exact licensed English name unverified.

rows.en: You mean restoring Tokyo to its original state and separating the two worlds?
rows.notes: Restoring original Tokyo and separating worlds both preserved as Quattro question.

rows.en: I don't think it is the best solution, but it is the only course we can take under the circumstances.
rows.notes: Only currently available course, not best solution; both qualifications retained.

rows.en: But JBB-1's T.J. Buster was damaged in the battle just now.
rows.notes: JBB-1 ship designation preserved without expansion; source specifies recent battle damage.
uncertain: T.J. Buster exact licensed English name unverified.

rows.en: Besides, even with all six working, I'm not sure they could generate enough energy to trigger the Jupiter phenomenon...
rows.notes: Six-unit count and doubts about enough energy preserved; deliberate trailing concern.
uncertain: Jupiter phenomenon is source loanword compound; exact licensed terminology unverified.

rows.en: I know that. But if we release the energy of Neriya Temple, or else...
rows.notes: Reply acknowledges energy objection; deliberate trailing alternative continues next row.
uncertain: Neriya Temple follows existing literal glossary; independently canonical licensed name unverified.

rows.en: If we use the real Star of Ra Mu instead of the RMU system...
rows.notes: Conditional alternative remains unfinished; real Star contrasted with RMU system, no new result added.
Vega surprise remains a brief exclamation; no inferred explanation.

rows.en: What's wrong!?
rows.notes: Soichi reacts to sudden report; no invented addressee.

rows.en: The D1 from earlier has appeared off Yakushima! It seems to be heading for Nirai Kanai!
rows.notes: Same earlier D1 appears offshore; heading toward Nirai Kanai is reported as apparent, not certain. Yakushima spelling centrally verified by JNTO; no extra geographical claims.

rows.en: W-what did you say!?
rows.notes: Stutter and shocked question retained.
